idea.title: ContextCraft — Codebase indexer for AI agents

plan.tagline: Instantly index and query your codebase with AI-friendly context
plan.problem: AI coding assistants struggle with large codebases due to lack of structured context, forcing developers to manually curate files and lose productivity
plan.solution: Indexes your codebase into a local SQLite database with file paths, dependencies, and metadata. Provides CLI commands to query and export context for AI agents or manual review. Works offline with --demo mode.
plan.target_market: Solo developers and small teams using AI coding tools who need reliable codebase context without complex setup
mvp_features: CLI commands to add/list/query codebase files
plan.demo_script: Run `contextcraft --demo` to see a hardcoded sample project indexed with 5 files, then query for Python files or dependencies. Shows JSON export ready for AI agents.
plan.phuket_angle: Thai small businesses running Python-based web apps (e.g., tourism booking systems) can use it to quickly onboard AI agents to their codebase without exposing sensitive data to cloud services
